text: Bhoot asli tha...\nya kisi ka KHEL?
Clue isi video\nmein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
Tab se haveli mein\nhar raat SAFED DHOTI\nwali AATMA ghoomti!
Darr ke maare sab\nhaveli chhodna\nchahte hain
Phir bada beta RAJAT\nek KHAT laaya
"12 March ko khud\nmere haath mein\ndiya tha..."
"Roz aatma ko shaant\nkarne ke liye pooja\nkarti hoon"
Shivam ne bhoot ka\nRAAZ khol diya!
Shivam ki nazar se\nkoi nahi bachta.
